0.start: Begin in a spacious underground station concourse with a polished concrete floor marked by a yellow safety line running down the center. Dominant features include a large blue and white ticket vending machine on the left, a green vending machine on the right, and a yellow directional sign overhead. Prominent landmarks include a curved ceiling with recessed lighting and a distant ticket booth with glass panels and signage.
0.turn_1: Facing away from the entrance, the room features a polished concrete floor and a large, reflective stainless steel wall on the right. Glass partitions divide the space into distinct sections, and a yellow dumpster sits near the left wall. Dominant objects include the stainless steel wall, glass partitions, and a white ceiling with fluorescent lights.
